name: Nigella Sativa
summary: Nigella sativa (Black Seed) is a traditional seed extract containing thymoquinone, studied for antioxidant and immune support.
description: Lean bulk ingestion row for Nigella sativa. Key active compounds include Thymoquinone.
safetyNotes: May reduce glucose, lipids, and blood pressure; monitor with antidiabetics, antihypertensives, anticoagulants, and antiplatelets. GI upset or allergic rash can occur.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
